findings.problem: Creating a new upgrade plan while viewing an older one reused the older render closure when loading receipts.
findings.impact: Prior success/failure/rollback state could be displayed on the new plan and disable installation.
findings.status: Root fixed explicit load(created.id); read-only patch check confirms correct selection and missing-row clearing.

findings.problem: Real GoalStore status=done was tested only against completed in TaskInspector and missing from shared translated labels.
findings.impact: Completed goals showed no checkmarks and 0/N, with raw enum text.
findings.status: Fixed by root and independently source-reviewed: goalDone accepts done/completed for count and checkmark; domain maps done/in_progress/pending/blocked to Chinese. New test renders real TaskInspector and checks 2/4, two checkmarks, and visible translated statuses.

findings.problem: Main settings CloudProviderForm lacks onConnected refresh callback.
findings.impact: New model does not immediately appear in App selection despite saved notice; wait for 30-second poll/focus.
findings.status: Fixed by root and independently source-reviewed: App refresh -> SettingsDialog refresh -> ProductSettings onModelsChanged -> CloudProviderForm onConnected, awaited after successful cloud save. Model catalog updates without waiting for periodic polling.

positive_findings: Submission clears draft only after accepted task response; failed submissions retain text.
Unknown side effects and active tasks block automatic new submission into the existing session.
Cancel requests stop and re-query the original task; no automatic tool replay.
Onboarding completion verifies Core readiness; no configured model is explicitly distinguished in the summary.
Native cloud configuration rejects malformed keys before storing; UI clears key after successful save and distinguishes API readiness from configuration.
final_status: All three concrete novice-flow findings addressed; no new issue in the bounded final patch review. No browser execution claim.
